ui_bugs.issue: data-testids do not match the review spec: implementation uses 'client-form-email', 'client-form-name', 'client-form-phone', 'client-form-submit' while spec requires the '-input'/'-button' suffix ('client-form-email-input', 'client-form-name-input', 'client-form-phone-input', 'client-form-submit-button'). Functionality works; only the contract naming differs.

After window.scrollY>28 the .site-header-inner border-radius computes to ~19.17px on 1920px viewport (getComputedStyle). Spec targets ~26px. Visually still a pill; consider bumping radius or accept as design choice.

action_items: OPTIONAL: rename ClientFormModal data-testids to end with '-input' / '-button' to match the review contract (see ClientFormModal.jsx lines 24–30).
OPTIONAL: increase .site-header-inner border-radius (currently ~19px on scroll) if the spec 26px is strict.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.js applies a global express.json() before any router; multer routes still work because express.json only parses when Content-Type is application/json. Multipart uploads succeed as long as the client does not force Content-Type: application/json on multipart requests (an issue on some SDKs). Consider adding an explicit skip via express.json({ type: 'application/json' }) or a raw route mount – already implicit but worth documenting.
adminRoutes /clients/import parses booleans from Excel via clientsExcel.parseClientsWorkbook. Verified 'Sí' becomes subscribed=true and invalid emails are counted as skipped.

publicRoutes /unsubscribe/:token masks the email but the mask uses '•' bullets which some Gmail clients may render as ??. Consider using '*' for wider compatibility (already handled – mask is only in the JSON response for the /baja page, not the sent email).

adminRoutes.campaigns POST returns 202 quickly and processes recipients in setImmediate with 600ms sleep between sends. Good pattern; consider adding a hard cap on recipients per campaign to avoid runaway sends.
SiteHeader hides HeaderSearch on catalog via showSearch=false prop; verified data-testid=header-search DOM node is absent on /canciones-karaoke-madrid.

SongRequestModal auto-submits on second open when localStorage okume-guest-email is set; verified the auto → success transition, and 'Change email' correctly clears both localStorage keys and reopens the form.
